notes: Adds an 'Open folder' button beside Settings in the popup. It opens a folder window straight at the run you just downloaded - for example 'Shopee daily report/24082026-Monday-0915' - so you do not have to go looking for it.

One honest limit: Chrome does not let an extension open your normal file manager window at a folder it did not download into. This opens Chrome's own folder window instead. You can see and open every file in it, then close it.

Makes the filenames identical on Windows, Mac and Linux. Each operating system bans different characters in a filename, so the same report could save on one machine and fail on another. There is now one rule, the strictest of the three, applied on all of them - so whichever computer you run this on, you get the same files under the same names.
